title: Bitwarden: free 1Password alternative
caption:
1Password charges $3.99/month. Bitwarden stores your passwords for free 🔐

✅ One encrypted vault for passwords, cards and notes
✅ Unlimited passwords on unlimited devices
✅ Built-in password generator
✅ No subscription, no password limits, free plan

💻 Any browser · Mac · Windows · Linux · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ The free plan covers the essentials. Extras like the built-in authenticator codes, file attachments and emergency access are in Premium at $19.80/year. The iPhone and Android apps live in separate GitHub repos

Comment "VAULT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
